correspondence.component_scope: Selected opening northeast of the Tucupita town setting and initial eastward then northeastward passage.
correspondence.finding: The original depicts a narrow continuous channel beside the northeastern road corridor, with the initial bend and subsequent north/northeast continuation. Road and settlement overprinting can be distinguished from the blue channel. The selected beginning is already within this delta-waterway network; it is not substituted with the much broader Macareo farther east or the unselected western river at Tucupita.
correspondence.part_index_basis: One-based stored-part numbering within the listed fragment.

correspondence.component_scope: Road-adjacent northeastward upper channel and its continuation beyond the road.
correspondence.finding: The continuous blue channel follows the road-adjacent passage and continues northeast through the wetland after the road ends. The original directly prints Caño Tucupita across this channel, distinguishing it from the wider southern/eastern Macareo reach and neighboring northern caños. The short bend and northward section between the stored parts are present.
correspondence.part_index_basis: One-based stored-part numbering within the listed fragment.

correspondence.component_scope: Northeastward Tucupita wetland corridor and its join into the broad Macareo receiver.
correspondence.finding: The thin selected channel continues northeast through successive bends and joins the western side of the broader Macareo corridor. The entire connecting line and receiver are visible, including the southern parallel Macareo arm and small island/channel setting. This is a mapped through-link rather than inference from proximity of two labels.
correspondence.part_index_basis: One-based stored-part numbering within the listed fragment.

correspondence.component_scope: Broad lower receiving channel, northeastward continuation and northward outer bend.
correspondence.finding: The selected continuation is within the broad waterway directly labeled CAÑO MACAREO. The map shows the successive lower bends, the island-bearing broader segment, minor lateral channels and the near-coastal northward turn. Nearby Cocuina and the eastern Mariusa island-channel setting are distinct unselected waterways.
correspondence.part_index_basis: One-based stored-part numbering within the listed fragment.

correspondence.component_scope: Northwestward final selected channel and approach to the coastal opening.
correspondence.finding: Beyond the northern bend, the broad Macareo channel turns northwest and remains continuously connected to the charted Barra de Macareo opening. Small lateral arms and near-mouth islands are depicted; the selected line does not switch into the separate western Cocuina outlet or continue around the eastern Mariusa channel.
correspondence.part_index_basis: One-based stored-part numbering within the listed fragment.

correspondence.component_scope: Separately retained original-source and rendered terminal settings.
correspondence.finding: The source terminal is in the broad lower Macareo approach short of the open coastal receiving area. The rendered terminal extends farther northwest toward the mapped Barra de Macareo opening beside its small near-mouth islands. Both settings and their intervening receiving passage are depicted on the original. They are described separately, without moving either point or equating a historical shoreline pixel with an exact modern mouth.
correspondence.part_index_basis: One-based stored-part numbering within the listed fragment.

correspondence.component_scope: Delta wetland channels and nearby small waterbodies over the complete selection.
correspondence.finding: The selection is represented throughout by connected mapped channels, with minor widenings and nearby wetland waterbodies. No separate selected through-lake, reservoir or engineered-control transfer is needed to explain this route. Nearby small lakes and other delta channels are not added to the selection. Ordinary channel-network correspondence does not require current-flow or operating evidence.
correspondence.part_index_basis: One-based stored-part numbering within the listed fragment.

correspondence.component_scope: Chosen southern feeder and its entry into the eastern upper lake system
correspondence.finding: The opening occupies a small northward-running upland drainage among elongated pools and low ridges. The detailed imagery shows its receiving channel and linked lake arm reaching the broad upper lake. The generalized selection cuts across local bends, but the ordinary receiving corridor is visible; no separate-basin or missing lake-to-feeder transfer is identified. This is a selected opening, not a claim to the unique natural source.

correspondence.component_scope: Broad upper lake passage and northwest/west outlet
correspondence.finding: The selected passage belongs to the broad lake and its western outlet channel. A separate eastern lake arm and side waters remain distinguishable from the chosen exit. The outlet continues into the same western receiving channel. Neither lake nor outlet receives a supported individual name from the inspected material.

correspondence.component_scope: Westward channel, a smaller elongated through-lake and its western outlet
correspondence.finding: The original imagery shows the westward channel reaching a smaller north-south elongated lake, continuing through its connected waterbody and leaving westward into a winding river. Tributary and side-pool entrances remain separate. The continuous lake/channel setting establishes ordinary correspondence without requiring the generalized line to match every bank or the present wetted thread.

correspondence.component_scope: Northwestward river bends and approach to the north-running middle corridor
correspondence.finding: The river follows a visible northwestward valley with alternating narrow channels, bends and small tributary junctions. It joins the north-running receiving corridor at the upper-middle transition. Nearby ponds are not substituted for the visible main receiving passage.

correspondence.component_scope: Northward and northwestward middle valley with tributary joins
correspondence.finding: The inspected middle enlargement shows a continuous valley and river from the upper transition through successive tributary joins, local channel splitting and reunions, and the northwest continuation. No major through-lake, glacier passage or managed impoundment is evident in this selected middle interval. Seasonal snow elsewhere in the imagery is not treated as a glacier.

correspondence.component_scope: Larger eastern tributary junction, lower northward bend and westward turn
correspondence.finding: The selected river receives a substantial eastern drainage, then follows the same broad corridor through a westward bend, a northward reach and another turn west. The lower image and overview overlap continuously. The eastern tributary is a joining context feature, not a separate selected fragment and not a name transferred to the selected river.

correspondence.component_scope: Northwestward lower valley and widened alluvial approach to the coast
correspondence.finding: The river continues through the lower valley, with visible bars, side channels and tributary joins, into the broader coastal alluvial corridor. The selected parts remain in this ordinary receiving setting; no separate managed canal, lake-basin transfer or unseen connection is needed to explain them.

correspondence.component_scope: Final northward lower river, stored source endpoint and rendered extension into the coastal inlet setting
correspondence.finding: The stored source endpoint lies in the lower estuarine river corridor before its opening into the wider inlet. The rendered extension proceeds farther north along the same coastal receiving-water margin and ends at the inlet-edge setting. These are distinct endpoints. The core sea class is retained only as supplied metadata; no precise tidal boundary or surveyed mouth point is inferred, and the selection is not extended through the rest of the inlet.

Parts1–8 are substantially obscured; parts9–11 contain intermittent exposed valley pieces but do not independently establish the continuous link back to the opening. correspondence.part_index_basis: One-based stored-part numbering within the listed fragment.

correspondence.component_scope: northward upper trunk to stage transition

correspondence.part_index_basis: One-based stored-part numbering within the listed fragment.

correspondence.component_scope: middle northward trunk and large eastern join
correspondence.finding: The middle trunk meanders north through low forested terrain, develops broad looping bends and receives the substantial eastern tributary near its downstream end. correspondence.part_index_basis: One-based stored-part numbering within the listed fragment.

correspondence.component_scope: lower trunk after tributary join

correspondence.finding: At the large lower division, a broad channel continues west while the selected branch continues north. correspondence.part_index_basis: One-based stored-part numbering within the listed fragment.
